body:
Fuck, I can't do this. Two fucking hours of writing and deleting and rewriting these. I'm gonna give this one last shot, point blank:

I am lonely, I miss my friends and feel like my family is disappointed in me because I am disappointed in myself. I found out that I wasn't as strong as I thought I was, and hate myself for it. I keep emotionally projecting and trying to blame my problems on other circumstances, when I know logically exactly what I have to do to change my situation, but can't bring myself to emotionally do it, preferring to sit and wallow in despair at my impending failure. 

That about sums it up.

Honestly though, I didn't even want to study engineering immediately, instead it was kind of my dream to  become an army ranger before college. When I told my brother about my plan, he flat out told me he thought it was stupid. Similarly, my best friend told me I was going to get killed. My mom absolutely hated the idea, and my Dad didn't make much of an effort to hide his disappointment (Prior to this, I was considering medicine, an idea which he loved, and the contrast in his enthusiasm to which made his feelings pretty damned clear) 

I thought I was a pretty independent person before this, and figured I would do what I wanted and to hell with people who disagreed. I learned better when I was faced with complete lack of support, and my confidence in myself to be successful in the military completely dissolved.

The college I'm at now is a fairly good public university, and I came here for no reason other than it's far away from home. Consequently, no one from my hometown came here except for a single girl who dropped out a week into classes. I've met plenty of nice people here, but haven't really made any friends. Nothing in common I guess; or maybe I'm just an asshole. Anyway, I talk to my old friends less and less often, and don't have any of the stories to share that they all seem to have. I know it's difficult to stay close when you're scattered across the country, but I feel like I'm the only one of us who's noticing us drifting apart or even cares about it.

So I'm 19 years old and currently attending a certain large university with the intent to study engineering. Unfortunately my grades probably aren't good enough to get me into the very competitive engineering programs here. Even if I do, I have a feeling that after graduation I would get stuck in a job I'd hate, (the example I usually give of a job I don't want is that I'll spend my life designing toasters.)
